summary: Reproduced at 9bde46e775df. exllamav3.modules.Conv constructed with out_dtype=torch.float (stored: torch.float32) returned torch.float16 from forward on an FP16 input, and forward(..., out_dtype=torch.float) also returned torch.float16: neither dtype option is applied.
what_ran: repro.py builds a 2-D Conv (3 -> 16 channels, kernel (4, 4)) over a tiny checkpoint tensor, loads it on physical GPU 1 and calls forward on a (1, 3, 8, 8) FP16 input, without and with the forward-level out_dtype.
limits: 2-D path only (3-D not run). No in-tree caller passes a differing out_dtype here.

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny checkpoint with one conv tensor generated by repro.py
